product_updates.title: Democrats launch Nvidia investigation, write scathing letter on Huang’s ‘scheme’ with Trump
product_updates.content: This Congressional investigation into Nvidia's China sales and its dealings with Trump is the second one, so far, since news of the alleged spy affair broke.

product_updates.title: Muse can now place calls to US businesses — if you pay
product_updates.content: Muse's AI can now place outbound calls to U.S. businesses — but it's not free.

product_updates.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
product_updates.content: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

product_updates.title: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
product_updates.content: Nebius plans to fund its $40 billion AI infrastructure expansion through customer prepayments and loans, even as delays at a Microsoft data center raise questions about its financing model.

product_updates.content: Reuters is withholding the name of the new employee linked to Huang, but says she is an employee of Nvidia.

product_updates.title: Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
product_updates.content: Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google's AI Mode is getting better at understanding complex queries, surfacing relevant links, and delivering richer visual responses.

product_updates.title: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
product_updates.content: Nectar's new AI agent automates influencer marketing, helping brands discover creators, manage outreach and partnerships, and track campaign results.

product_updates.title: Jensen Huang’s exit puts Nvidia’s support for open source in question
product_updates.content: Jensen Huang’s resignation raises questions about Nvidia’s commitment to open source AI, including its Hugging Face acquisition, open-weight models, and advocacy against restrictions, as the company navigates a leadership transition.

product_updates.title: Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit
product_updates.content: Hugging Face's CEO pledged to keep fighting for open source AI after Huang's exit, raising questions about Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition.

product_updates.title: United Airlines blocks AI agents from booking flights, citing cybersecurity risks
product_updates.content: The airline said it will not allow customers to use AI agents to book flights and manage reservations.
